baseline: snapshot of current fixed Python implementation, including local changes
candidate: opt-in cost-sensitive tree over prepared pair and SAT-with-pair-fallback policies
hypothesis: Cheap query features predict which bounded exact policy obtains independent verified relations with lower elapsed cost.
scope: CPU type-II ONB, same fixed base and summand count within each panel; prepared pair table and SAT circuit for routing diagnostics; full cold API invocation measured separately
domain: only observed curve/base/summand fingerprints and feature ranges; OOD uses pairs
split: SHA256 of canonical signed Frobenius orbit, independent of generator and factor base; residues 0..2 train, 3 validation, 4 confirmation
training: natural queries only; require both rank gains and failures; timeouts are unresolved, not unsatisfiable
cost: wall ns are diagnostics; common_ops, S, rho and floor ratios null until a full-process Python adapter is calibrated
performance_admission: not admitted to Rust CPU instruction tournament; no default promotion or performance claim
validation: A/A deterministic algebra replay; matched baseline/candidate complete small DLPs, three repetitions, locked fresh holdouts, independent field/group and rank audit; retain failures
degree131: parameter/OOD guard check only; no trained yield or completion extrapolation
falsification: If held-out loss improves less than 5%, deploy a learned constant policy within the observed domain. No mixed outcomes means reject training.
